question: The first level landcover types of the highest monthly average temperature in Canton Zurich in July 2010.
sql: WITH july_temps AS ( SELECT mt.latitude AS latitude, mt.longitude AS longitude, AVG ( mt.tmean ) AS avg_july_tmean_k, AVG ( mt.tmean ) - 273.15 AS avg_july_tmean_c FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean AS mt WHERE EXTRACT ( YEAR FROM mt.time ) = 2010 AND EXTRACT ( MONTH FROM mt.time ) = 7 AND mt.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6 AND mt.longitude BETWEEN 8.3 AND 8.8 GROUP BY mt.latitude, mt.longitude ) , max_temp_value AS ( SELECT MAX ( july_temps.avg_july_tmean_k ) AS highest_avg_k FROM july_temps ) , hottest_grids AS ( SELECT july_temps.latitude AS latitude, july_temps.longitude AS longitude, july_temps.avg_july_tmean_c AS avg_july_tmean_c FROM july_temps WHERE july_temps.avg_july_tmean_k = ( SELECT max_temp_value.highest_avg_k AS highest_avg_k FROM max_temp_value ) ) , level1_counts AS ( SELECT h.latitude AS latitude, h.longitude AS longitude, lt.level1_code AS level1_code, lt.level1_label AS level1_label, SUM ( u.ranks[i][2] ) AS total_count FROM hottest_grids AS h JOIN era5_land2.landcover_upscaled AS u ON u.latitude = h.latitude AND u.longitude = h.longitude CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS ( u.ranks, 1 ) AS i JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type AS lt ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1] GROUP BY h.latitude, h.longitude, lt.level1_code, lt.level1_label ) , dominant_per_grid AS ( SELECT level1_counts.latitude AS latitude, level1_counts.longitude AS longitude, level1_counts.level1_code AS level1_code, level1_counts.level1_label AS level1_label, level1_counts.total_count AS total_count, RANK ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY level1_counts.latitude, level1_counts.longitude ORDER BY level1_counts.total_count DESC ) AS rnk FROM level1_counts ) , hottest_dominant AS ( SELECT d.latitude AS latitude, d.longitude AS longitude, d.level1_code AS level1_code, d.level1_label AS dominant_level1_type, d.total_count AS dominant_count, ROUND ( CAST ( h.avg_july_tmean_c AS DECIMAL ) , 2 ) AS highest_avg_temp_c FROM dominant_per_grid AS d JOIN hottest_grids AS h ON h.latitude = d.latitude AND h.longitude = d.longitude WHERE d.rnk = 1 ) SELECT hottest_dominant.latitude AS latitude, hottest_dominant.longitude AS longitude, hottest_dominant.level1_code AS level1_code, hottest_dominant.dominant_level1_type AS dominant_level1_type, hottest_dominant.dominant_count AS dominant_count, hottest_dominant.highest_avg_temp_c AS highest_avg_temp_c FROM hottest_dominant ORDER BY latitude, longitude;;

question: List the different landcover types of City of Zurich.
sql:
SELECT lt.level1_code, lt.level1_label, lt.level2_code, lt.level2_label, lt.level3_code, lt.level3_label, landcover_filter.total_count
FROM (
    SELECT ranks[i][1] AS level3_code, SUM(ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled, generate_subscripts(ranks, 1) AS i
    WHERE latitude = 47.4 AND longitude = 8.5
    GROUP BY ranks[i][1]
    )
    AS landcover_filter
JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type lt ON lt.level3_code = landcover_filter.level3_code
ORDER BY landcover_filter.total_count DESC;

question: What are the top five dominant landcover types in the City of Zurich point?
sql:
SELECT landcover_filter.*, landcover_type.level3_label
FROM (
SELECT ranks[i][1] AS level3_code, sum(ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
FROM landcover_upscaled, generate_subscripts(ranks,1) AS i
WHERE latitude = 47.4 AND longitude = 8.5
GROUP BY ranks[i][1]) as landcover_filter
    JOIN landcover_type on landcover_filter.level3_code = landcover_type.level3_code
ORDER BY total_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the monthly average temperature for urban-dominated areas (defined in level 2) in the Canton of Zurich in 2010?
sql: WITH urban_level2_codes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT lt1.level2_code AS level2_code FROM landcover_type AS lt1 WHERE lt1.level2_label ILIKE '%urban%' ) , urban_dominant_grids AS ( SELECT u.latitude AS latitude, u.longitude AS longitude, dominant.level2_label AS level2_label FROM landcover_upscaled AS u CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT lt.level2_code AS level2_code, lt.level2_label AS level2_label, SUM ( u.ranks[i][2] ) AS total_count FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS ( u.ranks, 1 ) AS i JOIN landcover_type AS lt ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1] GROUP BY lt.level2_code, lt.level2_label ORDER BY total_count DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS dominant JOIN urban_level2_codes AS ul ON ul.level2_code = dominant.level2_code WHERE u.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 8.3 AND 8.8 ) , monthly_temps AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC ( 'MONTH', t.time ) AS month, AVG ( t.tmean - 273.15 ) AS avg_temp_c, ug.level2_label AS level2_label FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean AS t JOIN urban_dominant_grids AS ug ON ug.latitude = t.latitude AND ug.longitude = t.longitude WHERE EXTRACT ( YEAR FROM t.time ) = 2010 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC ( 'MONTH', t.time ) , ug.level2_label ) SELECT TO_CHAR ( monthly_temps.month, 'month' ) AS month, ROUND ( CAST ( monthly_temps.avg_temp_c AS DECIMAL ) , 2 ) AS monthly_average_temperature_c, ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM urban_dominant_grids ) AS num_urban_dominated_grid_cells_used FROM monthly_temps ORDER BY TO_CHAR ( month, 'MM' );;

question: Compare monthly average temperatures across 2020 between the dominant landcovers of forrest and urban in the Canton of Zurich.
sql: WITH forest_level2 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT lt1.level2_code AS level2_code FROM era5_land2.landcover_type AS lt1 WHERE lt1.level2_label ILIKE '%forest%' ) , urban_level2 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT lt2.level2_code AS level2_code FROM era5_land2.landcover_type AS lt2 WHERE lt2.level2_label ILIKE '%urban%' ) , dominant_grids AS ( SELECT u.latitude AS latitude, u.longitude AS longitude, CASE WHEN dom.level2_code IN ( SELECT forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code FROM forest_level2 ) THEN 'Forest' WHEN dom.level2_code IN ( SELECT urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code FROM urban_level2 ) THEN 'Urban' ELSE 'Other' END AS landcover_group FROM landcover_upscaled AS u CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT lt.level2_code AS level2_code, SUM ( u.ranks[i][2] ) AS total_count FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS ( u.ranks, 1 ) AS i JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type AS lt ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1] GROUP BY lt.level2_code ORDER BY total_count DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS dom WHERE u.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 8.3 AND 8.8 AND dom.level2_code IN ( SELECT forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code FROM forest_level2 UNION SELECT urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code FROM urban_level2 ) ) , monthly_temps AS ( SELECT dg.landcover_group AS landcover_group, DATE_TRUNC ( 'MONTH', t.time ) AS month, AVG ( t.tmean - 273 ) AS avg_temp_c, COUNT ( DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude ) AS num_grids FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean AS t JOIN dominant_grids AS dg ON dg.latitude = t.latitude AND dg.longitude = t.longitude WHERE EXTRACT ( YEAR FROM t.time ) = 2020 GROUP BY dg.landcover_group, DATE_TRUNC ( 'MONTH', t.time ) ) SELECT TO_CHAR ( monthly_temps.month, 'YYYY-MM' ) AS month, ROUND ( CAST ( MAX ( CASE WHEN monthly_temps.landcover_group = 'Forest' THEN monthly_temps.avg_temp_c END ) AS DECIMAL ) , 2 ) AS forest_avg_c, ROUND ( CAST ( MAX ( CASE WHEN monthly_temps.landcover_group = 'Urban' THEN monthly_temps.avg_temp_c END ) AS DECIMAL ) , 2 ) AS urban_avg_c, ROUND ( CAST ( MAX ( CASE WHEN monthly_temps.landcover_group = 'Urban' THEN monthly_temps.avg_temp_c END ) AS DECIMAL ) - CAST ( MAX ( CASE WHEN monthly_temps.landcover_group = 'Forest' THEN monthly_temps.avg_temp_c END ) AS DECIMAL ) , 2 ) AS urban_minus_forest_diff_c FROM monthly_temps GROUP BY monthly_temps.month ORDER BY month

question: For City of Zurich and Canton of Zurich, show the difference of their monthly average temperatures of August in 2015 with dominant landcover types respectively.
sql: WITH city_box AS ( SELECT lu.latitude AS latitude, lu.longitude AS longitude FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled AS lu WHERE lu.latitude BETWEEN 47.32 AND 47.42 AND lu.longitude BETWEEN 8.45 AND 8.62 ) , canton_box AS ( SELECT lu1.latitude AS latitude, lu1.longitude AS longitude FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled AS lu1 WHERE lu1.latitude BETWEEN 47.13 AND 47.74 AND lu1.longitude BETWEEN 8.22 AND 9.10 ) , dominant_in_area AS ( SELECT 'City of Zurich' AS area, lt.level2_code AS level2_code, lt.level2_label AS level2_label, SUM ( u.ranks[i][2] ) AS total_count FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled AS u CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS ( u.ranks, 1 ) AS i JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type AS lt ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1] JOIN city_box AS cb ON cb.latitude = u.latitude AND cb.longitude = u.longitude GROUP BY lt.level2_code, lt.level2_label UNION ALL SELECT 'Canton of Zurich' AS area, lt.level2_code AS level2_code, lt.level2_label AS level2_label, SUM ( u.ranks[i][2] ) AS total_count FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled AS u CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS ( u.ranks, 1 ) AS i JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type AS lt ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1] JOIN canton_box AS cb ON cb.latitude = u.latitude AND cb.longitude = u.longitude GROUP BY lt.level2_code, lt.level2_label ) , top_dominant AS ( SELECT dominant_in_area.area AS area, dominant_in_area.level2_code AS level2_code, dominant_in_area.level2_label AS dominant_level2_landcover, dominant_in_area.total_count AS total_count, RANK ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY dominant_in_area.area ORDER BY dominant_in_area.total_count DESC ) AS rnk FROM dominant_in_area ) , august_temps AS ( SELECT 'City of Zurich' AS area, AVG ( t.tmean - 273.15 ) AS avg_temp_c, COUNT ( DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude ) AS num_grids FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean AS t JOIN city_box AS cb ON cb.latitude = t.latitude AND cb.longitude = t.longitude WHERE EXTRACT ( YEAR FROM t.time ) = 2015 AND EXTRACT ( MONTH FROM t.time ) = 8 GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Canton of Zurich' AS area, AVG ( t.tmean - 273.15 ) AS avg_temp_c, COUNT ( DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude ) AS num_grids FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean AS t JOIN canton_box AS cb ON cb.latitude = t.latitude AND cb.longitude = t.longitude WHERE EXTRACT ( YEAR FROM t.time ) = 2015 AND EXTRACT ( MONTH FROM t.time ) = 8 GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT ROUND ( CAST ( MAX ( CASE WHEN august_temps.area = 'City of Zurich' THEN august_temps.avg_temp_c END ) AS DECIMAL ) , 2 ) AS city_avg_c, ROUND ( CAST ( MAX ( CASE WHEN august_temps.area = 'Canton of Zurich' THEN august_temps.avg_temp_c END ) AS DECIMAL ) , 2 ) AS canton_avg_c, ROUND ( CAST ( ( MAX ( CASE WHEN august_temps.area = 'City of Zurich' THEN august_temps.avg_temp_c END ) - MAX ( CASE WHEN august_temps.area = 'Canton of Zurich' THEN august_temps.avg_temp_c END ) ) AS DECIMAL ) , 2 ) AS city_minus_canton_difference_c FROM august_temps;;

question: For Canton of Zurich and Canton of Bern, show the difference of their monthly average temperatures of August in 2015 with the urban-dominant landcover type.
sql:
WITH urban_level2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT level2_code
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_type
    WHERE level2_label ILIKE '%urban%'
),
zurich_grids AS (
    SELECT latitude, longitude
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled
    WHERE latitude BETWEEN 47.13 AND 47.74
      AND longitude BETWEEN 8.22 AND 9.10
),
bern_grids AS (
    SELECT latitude, longitude
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled
    WHERE latitude BETWEEN 46.3 AND 47.3
      AND longitude BETWEEN 7.0 AND 8.2
),
urban_dominant_zurich AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        u.latitude,
        u.longitude,
        'Canton of Zurich' AS canton
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled u
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            lt.level2_code,
            SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
        FROM generate_subscripts(u.ranks, 1) AS i
        JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type lt ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
        GROUP BY lt.level2_code
        ORDER BY total_count DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) dom
    JOIN urban_level2 ul ON ul.level2_code = dom.level2_code
    JOIN zurich_grids zg ON zg.latitude = u.latitude AND zg.longitude = u.longitude
),
urban_dominant_bern AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        u.latitude,
        u.longitude,
        'Canton of Bern' AS canton
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled u
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            lt.level2_code,
            SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
        FROM generate_subscripts(u.ranks, 1) AS i
        JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type lt ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
        GROUP BY lt.level2_code
        ORDER BY total_count DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) dom
    JOIN urban_level2 ul ON ul.level2_code = dom.level2_code
    JOIN bern_grids bg ON bg.latitude = u.latitude AND bg.longitude = u.longitude
),
urban_grids AS (
    SELECT * FROM urban_dominant_zurich
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM urban_dominant_bern
),
august_2015_temps AS (
    SELECT
        ug.canton,
        AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_august_temp_c,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude) AS num_urban_dominant_grids,
        MIN(t.tmean - 273.15) AS min_temp_c,
        MAX(t.tmean - 273.15) AS max_temp_c
    FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean t
    JOIN urban_grids ug
        ON ug.latitude = t.latitude
       AND ug.longitude = t.longitude
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM t.time) = 2015
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.time) = 8
    GROUP BY ug.canton
)
SELECT
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN canton = 'Canton of Zurich' THEN avg_august_temp_c END)::numeric, 2) AS zurich_urban_avg_c,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN canton = 'Canton of Bern' THEN avg_august_temp_c END)::numeric, 2) AS bern_urban_avg_c,
    ROUND(
        (COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN canton = 'Canton of Zurich' THEN avg_august_temp_c END), 0) -
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN canton = 'Canton of Bern' THEN avg_august_temp_c END), 0))::numeric,
        2
    ) AS zurich_urban_minus_bern_urban_diff_c
FROM august_2015_temps;

question: Retrieve the mean temperature data on 01.01.2020 in Canton Zurich where the dominant landcover type is urban.
sql:
SELECT t.latitude, t.longitude, AVG(t.tmean) - 273 AS mean_temperature_c, lf.level3_code, lf.level3_label AS dominant_urban_landcover_label, lf.total_count AS dominant_count
FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean t
    INNER JOIN (
    SELECT u.latitude, u.longitude, u.ranks[1][1] AS level3_code, u.ranks[1][2] AS total_count, lt.level3_label
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled u
        JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type lt ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[1][1]
    WHERE u.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6 AND ( u.longitude BETWEEN 8.3 AND 8.8 ) AND lt.level3_label ILIKE '%urban%' )
        lf ON lf.latitude = t.latitude AND lf.longitude = t.longitude
WHERE DATE(t.time) = '2020-01-01'
GROUP BY t.latitude, t.longitude, lf.level3_code, lf.level3_label, lf.total_count ORDER BY t.latitude, t.longitude;

question: What is the mean temperature in the canton of Zurich on 01.06.2020 in areas that includes forests.
sql:
SELECT t.latitude, t.longitude, t.tmean - 273 AS temperature_mean,
       ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT lt.level3_code) AS forest_related_codes_present,
       ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT lt.level3_label) AS forest_related_labels_present
FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean t
    JOIN era5_land2.landcover_upscaled u ON u.latitude = t.latitude AND u.longitude = t.longitude
    CROSS JOIN unnest(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(val, idx)
    JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type lt ON lt.level3_code = val
WHERE t.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6 AND t.longitude BETWEEN 8.3 AND 8.8
  AND DATE(t.time) = '2020-06-01'
  AND lt.level3_label ILIKE '%forest%'
  AND idx % 2 = 1
GROUP BY t.latitude, t.longitude, t.tmean
ORDER BY t.latitude, t.longitude;

question: Find the monthly average mean temperature for the parts of Canton of Zurich with lakes in March over 2020.
sql:
WITH water_grids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.latitude, u.longitude
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled u
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY as r(code, idx)
        JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type lt ON lt.level3_code = code
    WHERE u.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 8.3 AND 8.8
      AND lt.level3_label ILIKE '%water%' AND idx % 2 = 1
    ),
march_temps AS (
    SELECT t.latitude, t.longitude, AVG(t.tmean) AS avg_march_tmean
    FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean t
        JOIN water_grids lg ON lg.latitude = t.latitude AND lg.longitude = t.longitude
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM t.time) = 2020
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.time) = 3
    GROUP BY t.latitude, t.longitude
    )
SELECT latitude, longitude,
       ROUND(avg_march_tmean::numeric, 2) - 273 AS avg_march_mean_temperature_celsius
FROM march_temps
ORDER BY latitude, longitude;

question: For Canton of Zurich, compare the dominant landcovers and their monthly average temperatures of August between 2010 and 2015.
sql:
WITH forest_level2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT level2_code
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_type
    WHERE level2_label ILIKE '%forest%'
),
urban_level2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT level2_code
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_type
    WHERE level2_label ILIKE '%urban%'
),
dominant_per_grid_raw AS (
    SELECT
        u.latitude,
        u.longitude,
        lt.level2_code AS dominant_level2_code,
        lt.level2_label AS dominant_level2_label,
        lt.level1_code,
        lt.level1_label,
        CASE
            WHEN lt.level2_code IN (SELECT level2_code FROM forest_level2) THEN 'Forest-dominated'
            WHEN lt.level2_code IN (SELECT level2_code FROM urban_level2) THEN 'Urban-dominated'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS landcover_group,
        SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS dominant_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY u.latitude, u.longitude
            ORDER BY SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled u
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_subscripts(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type lt
        ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    WHERE u.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6
      AND u.longitude BETWEEN 8.3 AND 8.8
    GROUP BY
        u.latitude, u.longitude,
        lt.level2_code, lt.level2_label, lt.level1_code, lt.level1_label
),
dominant_per_grid AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM dominant_per_grid_raw
    WHERE rn = 1
),
august_temps AS (
    SELECT
        d.landcover_group,
        d.dominant_level2_label,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) AS year,
        AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_august_temp_c,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude) AS num_grids
    FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean t
    JOIN dominant_per_grid d
        ON d.latitude = t.latitude
       AND d.longitude = t.longitude
    WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2010 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.time) = 8)
   OR (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2015 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.time) = 8)
    GROUP BY
        d.landcover_group,
        d.dominant_level2_label,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time)
)
SELECT
    year,
    landcover_group,
    dominant_level2_label AS most_common_dominant_type_in_group,
    ROUND(avg_august_temp_c::numeric, 2) AS avg_august_temperature_c,
    num_grids AS number_of_grid_cells
FROM august_temps
ORDER BY year, landcover_group, avg_august_temp_c DESC;

question: What is the average percentage of each landcover type across the Canton of Zurich's?
sql:
WITH canton_totals AS (
SELECT ranks[i][1] AS level3_code, SUM(ranks[i][2]) AS total_type_count
FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled u, generate_subscripts(u.ranks, 1) AS i
WHERE u.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 8.3 AND 8.8
GROUP BY ranks[i][1] ),
grand_total AS (
SELECT SUM(total_type_count) AS total_all_counts FROM canton_totals )
SELECT lt.level1_code, lt.level1_label, lt.level2_code, lt.level2_label, lt.level3_code, lt.level3_label, ct.total_type_count, ROUND((ct.total_type_count::numeric / gt.total_all_counts) * 100, 2) AS percentage_across_canton
FROM canton_totals ct
    CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
    JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type lt ON lt.level3_code = ct.level3_code
ORDER BY percentage_across_canton DESC;

question: What is percentage of forests in the canton of Zurich, Bern and Geneva?
sql:
WITH regional_landcover_entries AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 8.3 AND 8.8 THEN 'Zurich'
            WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 46.3 AND 47.4 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 7.0 AND 8.0 THEN 'Bern'
            WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 46.1 AND 46.3 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 5.9 AND 6.3 THEN 'Geneva'
        END AS canton_name,
        lt.level3_label
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled u
    CROSS JOIN unnest(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(val, idx)
    JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type lt ON lt.level3_code = val
    WHERE idx % 2 = 1 -- Only look at the type codes
)
SELECT
    canton_name,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE level3_label ILIKE '%forest%') / COUNT(*), 2) AS forest_entry_percentage
FROM regional_landcover_entries
WHERE canton_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY canton_name
ORDER BY forest_entry_percentage DESC;

question: How did the annual average mean temperature in <urban>-dominated areas of the Canton of Zurich in 2020 deviate from the 1991–2020 baseline?
sql:
WITH dominant_level3_grids AS (
    SELECT
        u.latitude,
        u.longitude,
        dom.level3_label
    FROM era5_land2.landcover_upscaled u
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            lt.level3_label,
            SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
        FROM generate_subscripts(u.ranks, 1) AS i
        JOIN era5_land2.landcover_type lt
            ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
        GROUP BY lt.level3_label
        ORDER BY total_count DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) dom
    WHERE u.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6
      AND u.longitude BETWEEN 8.3 AND 8.8
      AND dom.level3_label ILIKE '%urban%'
),
temp_2020 AS (
    SELECT AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_temp_2020_c
    FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean t
    JOIN dominant_level3_grids g
      ON g.latitude = t.latitude
     AND g.longitude = t.longitude
    WHERE t.time >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp
      AND t.time <  '2021-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp
),
baseline_1991_2020 AS (
    SELECT AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS baseline_avg_temp_c
    FROM era5_land2.meteo_tmean t
    JOIN dominant_level3_grids g
      ON g.latitude = t.latitude
     AND g.longitude = t.longitude

    mt.tmean AS tmean_k,

  WHERE

    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mt.time) = 7
    AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM mt.time) = 15
    AND (ROUND(CAST(mt.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(mt.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((47.4, 8.6))

    july15_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    july15_temps.tmean_c AS tmean_c
  FROM july15_temps
  WHERE
    july15_temps.tmean_k = (
      SELECT
        max_temp_value.highest_tmean_k AS highest_tmean_k
      FROM max_temp_value
    )
), level1_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,
    h.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
    lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
  FROM hottest_grid AS h
  JOIN landcover_upscaled AS u
    ON u.latitude = h.latitude AND u.longitude = h.longitude
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i

    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]

    CASE

        SELECT
          forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM forest_level2
      )
      THEN 'Forest'
      WHEN dom.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code

      THEN 'Urban'
      ELSE 'Other'

question: What is the percentage of each landcover type in the canton of City of Athens?
sql:
WITH canton_totals AS (
  SELECT
    u.ranks[i][1] AS level3_code,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_type_count
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u, GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  WHERE
    (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((38.0, 23.7))
  GROUP BY
    u.ranks[i][1]
), grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(canton_totals.total_type_count) AS total_all_counts
  FROM canton_totals
)
SELECT
  lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
  lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
  lt.level2_code AS level2_code,
  lt.level2_label AS level2_label,
  lt.level3_code AS level3_code,
  lt.level3_label AS level3_label,
  ct.total_type_count AS total_type_count,
  ROUND((
    CAST(ct.total_type_count AS DECIMAL) / gt.total_all_counts
  ) * 100, 2) AS percentage_across_canton
FROM canton_totals AS ct
CROSS JOIN grand_total AS gt
JOIN landcover_type AS lt
  ON lt.level3_code = ct.level3_code
ORDER BY
  percentage_across_canton DESC

WITH regional_landcover_entries AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((38.0, 23.7))
      THEN 'City of Athens'
      WHEN (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((47, 7.5))
      THEN 'Canton of Bern'
      WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 46.1 AND 46.3 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 5.9 AND 6.3
      THEN 'Geneva'
    END AS canton_name,
    lt.level3_label AS level3_label
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(val, idx)
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = r.val
  WHERE
    r.idx % 2 = 1
)
SELECT
  regional_landcover_entries.canton_name AS canton_name,
  ROUND(
    CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      regional_landcover_entries.level3_label ILIKE '%forest%') / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL),
    2
  ) AS forest_entry_percentage
FROM regional_landcover_entries
WHERE
  NOT regional_landcover_entries.canton_name IS NULL
GROUP BY
  regional_landcover_entries.canton_name
ORDER BY
  forest_entry_percentage DESC

WITH dominant_level3_grids AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    dom.level3_label AS level3_label
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level3_label AS level3_label,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level3_label
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  WHERE
    (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((38.0, 23.7))
    AND dom.level3_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), temp_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_temp_2020_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_level3_grids AS g
    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    t.time >= CAST('2020-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
), baseline_1991_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS baseline_avg_temp_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_level3_grids AS g
    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    t.time >= CAST('1991-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
)

  ROUND(CAST((
    t20.avg_temp_2020_c - b.baseline_avg_temp_c
  ) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS anomaly_c
FROM temp_2020 AS t20
CROSS JOIN baseline_1991_2020 AS b

WITH july15_temps AS (
  SELECT
    mt.latitude AS latitude,
    mt.longitude AS longitude,
    mt.tmean AS tmean_k,
    mt.tmean - 273.15 AS tmean_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS mt
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mt.time) = 2010
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mt.time) = 7
    AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM mt.time) = 15
    AND mt.latitude >= 35.3
    AND mt.latitude <= 35.3
    AND mt.longitude >= 25.1
    AND mt.longitude <= 25.1
), max_temp_value AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(july15_temps.tmean_k) AS highest_tmean_k
  FROM july15_temps
), hottest_grid AS (
  SELECT
    july15_temps.latitude AS latitude,
    july15_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    july15_temps.tmean_c AS tmean_c
  FROM july15_temps
  WHERE
    july15_temps.tmean_k = (
      SELECT
        max_temp_value.highest_tmean_k AS highest_tmean_k
      FROM max_temp_value
    )
), level1_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,
    h.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
    lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
  FROM hottest_grid AS h
  JOIN landcover_upscaled AS u
    ON u.latitude = h.latitude AND u.longitude = h.longitude
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
  GROUP BY
    h.latitude,
    h.longitude,
    lt.level1_code,
    lt.level1_label
), dominant_per_grid AS (
  SELECT
    level1_counts.latitude AS latitude,
    level1_counts.longitude AS longitude,
    level1_counts.level1_code AS level1_code,
    level1_counts.level1_label AS level1_label,
    level1_counts.total_count AS total_count,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY level1_counts.latitude, level1_counts.longitude
      ORDER BY level1_counts.total_count DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM level1_counts
), hottest_dominant AS (
  SELECT
    d.latitude AS latitude,
    d.longitude AS longitude,
    d.level1_code AS level1_code,
    d.level1_label AS dominant_level1_type,
    d.total_count AS dominant_count,
    ROUND(CAST(h.tmean_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS highest_avg_temp_c
  FROM dominant_per_grid AS d
  JOIN hottest_grid AS h
    ON h.latitude = d.latitude AND h.longitude = d.longitude
  WHERE
    d.rnk = 1
)
SELECT
  hottest_dominant.latitude AS latitude,
  hottest_dominant.longitude AS longitude,
  hottest_dominant.level1_code AS level1_code,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_level1_type AS dominant_level1_type,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_count AS dominant_count,
  hottest_dominant.highest_avg_temp_c AS highest_avg_temp_c

WITH july15_temps AS (
  SELECT
    mt.latitude AS latitude,
    mt.longitude AS longitude,
    mt.tmean AS tmean_k,
    mt.tmean - 273.15 AS tmean_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS mt
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mt.time) = 2010
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mt.time) = 7
    AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM mt.time) = 15
    AND mt.latitude >= 39.0
    AND mt.latitude <= 40.2
    AND mt.longitude >= 21.1
    AND mt.longitude <= 24.4
), max_temp_value AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(july15_temps.tmean_k) AS highest_tmean_k
  FROM july15_temps
), hottest_grid AS (
  SELECT
    july15_temps.latitude AS latitude,
    july15_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    july15_temps.tmean_c AS tmean_c
  FROM july15_temps
  WHERE
    july15_temps.tmean_k = (
      SELECT
        max_temp_value.highest_tmean_k AS highest_tmean_k
      FROM max_temp_value
    )
), level1_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,
    h.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
    lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
  FROM hottest_grid AS h
  JOIN landcover_upscaled AS u
    ON u.latitude = h.latitude AND u.longitude = h.longitude
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
  GROUP BY
    h.latitude,
    h.longitude,
    lt.level1_code,
    lt.level1_label
), dominant_per_grid AS (
  SELECT
    level1_counts.latitude AS latitude,
    level1_counts.longitude AS longitude,
    level1_counts.level1_code AS level1_code,
    level1_counts.level1_label AS level1_label,
    level1_counts.total_count AS total_count,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY level1_counts.latitude, level1_counts.longitude
      ORDER BY level1_counts.total_count DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM level1_counts
), hottest_dominant AS (
  SELECT
    d.latitude AS latitude,
    d.longitude AS longitude,
    d.level1_code AS level1_code,
    d.level1_label AS dominant_level1_type,
    d.total_count AS dominant_count,
    ROUND(CAST(h.tmean_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS highest_avg_temp_c
  FROM dominant_per_grid AS d
  JOIN hottest_grid AS h
    ON h.latitude = d.latitude AND h.longitude = d.longitude
  WHERE
    d.rnk = 1
)
SELECT
  hottest_dominant.latitude AS latitude,
  hottest_dominant.longitude AS longitude,
  hottest_dominant.level1_code AS level1_code,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_level1_type AS dominant_level1_type,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_count AS dominant_count,
  hottest_dominant.highest_avg_temp_c AS highest_avg_temp_c

question: Compare annual average temperatures in 2021 between the dominant landcovers of forest and urban in the Canton of Zurich.
sql:
WITH forest_level2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lt1.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt1
  WHERE
    lt1.level2_label ILIKE '%forest%'
), urban_level2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lt2.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt2
  WHERE
    lt2.level2_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), dominant_grids AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    CASE
      WHEN dom.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM forest_level2
      )
      THEN 'Forest'
      WHEN dom.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM urban_level2
      )
      THEN 'Urban'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS landcover_group
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level2_code AS level2_code,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level2_code
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  WHERE
    u.latitude BETWEEN 38.0 AND 38.0
    AND u.longitude BETWEEN 23.7 AND 23.7
    AND dom.level2_code IN (
      SELECT
        forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
      FROM forest_level2
      UNION
      SELECT
        urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
      FROM urban_level2
    )
), annual_temps AS (
  SELECT
    dg.landcover_group AS landcover_group,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) AS year,
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_temp_c,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude) AS num_grids
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_grids AS dg
    ON dg.latitude = t.latitude AND dg.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2021
  GROUP BY
    dg.landcover_group,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time)
)
SELECT
  MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Forest' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) AS forest_avg_c,
  MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Urban' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) AS urban_avg_c,
  MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Urban' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) - MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Forest' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END

question: What is the mean temperature in the canton of City of Athens on 15.07.2020 in areas that include forests?
sql:
SELECT
  t.latitude AS latitude,
  t.longitude AS longitude,
  t.tmean - 273.15 AS temperature_mean,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT lt.level3_code) AS forest_related_codes_present,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT lt.level3_label) AS forest_related_labels_present
FROM meteo_tmean AS t
JOIN landcover_upscaled AS u
  ON u.latitude = t.latitude AND u.longitude = t.longitude
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(val, idx)
JOIN landcover_type AS lt
  ON lt.level3_code = r.val
WHERE
  t.latitude >= 38.0
  AND t.latitude <= 38.0
  AND t.longitude >= 23.7
  AND t.longitude <= 23.7
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2020
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.time) = 7
  AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t.time) = 15
  AND lt.level3_label ILIKE '%forest%'
  AND r.idx % 2 = 1
GROUP BY
  t.latitude,
  t.longitude,
  t.tmean
ORDER BY
  latitude,
  longitude

question: List the different landcover types of City of Athens.

  lt.level1_label AS level1_label,

  landcover_filter.total_count AS total_count
FROM (

) AS landcover_filter
JOIN landcover_type AS lt
  ON lt.level3_code = landcover_filter.level3_code
ORDER BY
  landcover_filter.total_count DESC

question: What is the percentage of each landcover type in the canton of City of Athens?
sql:
WITH canton_totals AS (
  SELECT
    u.ranks[i][1] AS level3_code,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_type_count
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u, GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  WHERE
    u.latitude BETWEEN 38.0 AND 38.0 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 23.7 AND 23.7
  GROUP BY
    u.ranks[i][1]
), grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(canton_totals.total_type_count) AS total_all_counts
  FROM canton_totals
)
SELECT
  lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
  lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
  lt.level2_code AS level2_code,

  lt.level3_code AS level3_code,
  lt.level3_label AS level3_label,
  ct.total_type_count AS total_type_count,
  ROUND((
    CAST(ct.total_type_count AS DECIMAL) / gt.total_all_counts
  ) * 100, 2) AS percentage_across_canton
FROM canton_totals AS ct
CROSS JOIN grand_total AS gt
JOIN landcover_type AS lt
  ON lt.level3_code = ct.level3_code
ORDER BY
  percentage_across_canton DESC

question: What is the percentage of land area covered by forests in the cantons of Zurich, Bern, and Geneva, based on the landcover composition data?
sql:
WITH regional_landcover_entries AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 38.0 AND 38.0 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 23.7 AND 23.7
      THEN 'City of Athens'
      WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 46.3 AND 47.4 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 7 AND 8
      THEN 'Canton of Bern'
      WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 46.1 AND 46.3 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 5.9 AND 6.3
      THEN 'Geneva'
    END AS canton_name,
    lt.level3_label AS level3_label
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(val, idx)
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = r.val
  WHERE
    r.idx % 2 = 1
)
SELECT
  regional_landcover_entries.canton_name AS canton_name,
  ROUND(
    CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      regional_landcover_entries.level3_label ILIKE '%forest%') / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL),
    2
  ) AS forest_entry_percentage
FROM regional_landcover_entries
WHERE
  NOT regional_landcover_entries.canton_name IS NULL
GROUP BY
  regional_landcover_entries.canton_name
ORDER BY
  forest_entry_percentage DESC

question: How did the annual average mean temperature in <urban>-dominated areas of City of Athens in 2020 deviate from the 1991–2020 baseline?
sql:
WITH dominant_level3_grids AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    dom.level3_label AS level3_label
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level3_label AS level3_label,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level3_label
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  WHERE
    u.latitude BETWEEN 38.0 AND 38.0
    AND u.longitude BETWEEN 23.7 AND 23.7
    AND dom.level3_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), temp_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_temp_2020_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_level3_grids AS g
    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    t.time >= CAST('2020-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
), baseline_1991_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS baseline_avg_temp_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_level3_grids AS g
    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    t.time >= CAST('1991-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(CAST(t20.avg_temp_2020_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_temp_2020_c,
  ROUND(CAST(b.baseline_avg_temp_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS baseline_1991_2020_c,
  ROUND(CAST((
    t20.avg_temp_2020_c - b.baseline_avg_temp_c
  ) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS anomaly_c
FROM temp_2020 AS t20
CROSS JOIN baseline_1991_2020 AS b

Retrieve the mean temperature data on 15.07.2020 in Peloponnese where the dominant landcover type is urban.
Retrieve the mean temperature data during the first week of 2020 in Canton Zurich where the dominant landcover type is urban.
sql:
SELECT
  t.latitude AS latitude,
  t.longitude AS longitude,
  AVG(t.tmean) - 273.15 AS mean_temperature_c,
  lf.level3_code AS level3_code,
  lf.level3_label AS dominant_urban_landcover_label,
  lf.total_count AS dominant_count
FROM meteo_tmean AS t
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    u.ranks[1][1] AS level3_code,
    u.ranks[1][2] AS total_count,
    lt.level3_label AS level3_label
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[1][1]
  WHERE
    (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((38.0, 23.7))
    AND lt.level3_label ILIKE '%urban%'
) AS lf
  ON lf.latitude = t.latitude AND lf.longitude = t.longitude
WHERE
  EXTRACT(WEEK FROM t.time) = 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2020
GROUP BY
  t.latitude,
  t.longitude,
  lf.level3_code,
  lf.level3_label,
  lf.total_count
ORDER BY
  latitude,
  longitude

question: What is the percentage of each landcover type in the canton of City of Athens?
sql:
WITH canton_totals AS (
  SELECT
    u.ranks[i][1] AS level3_code,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_type_count
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u, GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  WHERE
    (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((38.0, 23.7))
  GROUP BY
    u.ranks[i][1]
), grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(canton_totals.total_type_count) AS total_all_counts
  FROM canton_totals
)
SELECT
  lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
  lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
  lt.level2_code AS level2_code,
  lt.level2_label AS level2_label,
  lt.level3_code AS level3_code,
  lt.level3_label AS level3_label,
  ct.total_type_count AS total_type_count,
  ROUND((
    CAST(ct.total_type_count AS DECIMAL) / gt.total_all_counts
  ) * 100, 2) AS percentage_across_canton
FROM canton_totals AS ct
CROSS JOIN grand_total AS gt
JOIN landcover_type AS lt
  ON lt.level3_code = ct.level3_code
ORDER BY
  percentage_across_canton DESC

WITH regional_landcover_entries AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((38.0, 23.7))
      THEN 'City of Athens'
      WHEN (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((47, 7.5))
      THEN 'Canton of Bern'
      WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 46.1 AND 46.3 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 5.9 AND 6.3
      THEN 'Geneva'
    END AS canton_name,
    lt.level3_label AS level3_label
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(val, idx)
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = r.val
  WHERE
    r.idx % 2 = 1
)
SELECT
  regional_landcover_entries.canton_name AS canton_name,
  ROUND(
    CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      regional_landcover_entries.level3_label ILIKE '%forest%') / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL),
    2
  ) AS forest_entry_percentage
FROM regional_landcover_entries
WHERE
  NOT regional_landcover_entries.canton_name IS NULL
GROUP BY
  regional_landcover_entries.canton_name
ORDER BY
  forest_entry_percentage DESC

WITH dominant_level3_grids AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    dom.level3_label AS level3_label
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level3_label AS level3_label,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level3_label
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  WHERE
    (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((38.0, 23.7))
    AND dom.level3_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), temp_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_temp_2020_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_level3_grids AS g
    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    t.time >= CAST('2020-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
), baseline_1991_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS baseline_avg_temp_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_level3_grids AS g
    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    t.time >= CAST('1991-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(CAST(t20.avg_temp_2020_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_temp_2020_c,
  ROUND(CAST(b.baseline_avg_temp_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS baseline_1991_2020_c,
  ROUND(CAST((
    t20.avg_temp_2020_c - b.baseline_avg_temp_c
  ) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS anomaly_c
FROM temp_2020 AS t20
CROSS JOIN baseline_1991_2020 AS b

WITH january_temps AS (
  SELECT
    mt.latitude AS latitude,
    mt.longitude AS longitude,
    AVG(mt.tmean) AS avg_january_tmean_k,
    AVG(mt.tmean) - 273.15 AS avg_january_tmean_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS mt
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mt.time) = 2011
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mt.time) = 1
    AND mt.latitude >= 47.2
    AND mt.latitude <= 47.7
    AND mt.longitude >= 8.4
    AND mt.longitude <= 9.0
  GROUP BY
    mt.latitude,
    mt.longitude
), max_temp_value AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(january_temps.avg_january_tmean_k) AS highest_avg_k
  FROM january_temps
), hottest_grids AS (
  SELECT
    january_temps.latitude AS latitude,
    january_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    january_temps.avg_january_tmean_c AS avg_january_tmean_c
  FROM january_temps
  WHERE
    january_temps.avg_january_tmean_k = (
      SELECT
        max_temp_value.highest_avg_k AS highest_avg_k
      FROM max_temp_value
    )
), level1_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,
    h.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
    lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
  FROM hottest_grids AS h
  JOIN landcover_upscaled AS u
    ON u.latitude = h.latitude AND u.longitude = h.longitude
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
  GROUP BY
    h.latitude,
    h.longitude,
    lt.level1_code,
    lt.level1_label
), dominant_per_grid AS (
  SELECT
    level1_counts.latitude AS latitude,
    level1_counts.longitude AS longitude,
    level1_counts.level1_code AS level1_code,
    level1_counts.level1_label AS level1_label,
    level1_counts.total_count AS total_count,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY level1_counts.latitude, level1_counts.longitude
      ORDER BY level1_counts.total_count DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM level1_counts
), hottest_dominant AS (
  SELECT
    d.latitude AS latitude,
    d.longitude AS longitude,
    d.level1_code AS level1_code,
    d.level1_label AS dominant_level1_type,
    d.total_count AS dominant_count,
    ROUND(CAST(h.avg_january_tmean_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS highest_avg_temp_c
  FROM dominant_per_grid AS d
  JOIN hottest_grids AS h
    ON h.latitude = d.latitude AND h.longitude = d.longitude
  WHERE
    d.rnk = 1
)
SELECT
  hottest_dominant.latitude AS latitude,
  hottest_dominant.longitude AS longitude,
  hottest_dominant.level1_code AS level1_code,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_level1_type AS dominant_level1_type,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_count AS dominant_count,
  hottest_dominant.highest_avg_temp_c AS highest_avg_temp_c
FROM hottest_dominant
ORDER BY
  latitude,
  longitude

  SELECT
    mt.latitude AS latitude,
    mt.longitude AS longitude,
    AVG(mt.tmean) AS avg_annual_tmean_k,
    AVG(mt.tmean) - 273.15 AS avg_annual_tmean_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS mt
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mt.time) = 2010
    AND mt.latitude >= 34.7
    AND mt.latitude <= 35.8
    AND mt.longitude >= 23.4
    AND mt.longitude <= 26.5
  GROUP BY
    mt.latitude,
    mt.longitude
), max_temp_value AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_k) AS highest_avg_k
  FROM annual_temps
), hottest_grids AS (
  SELECT
    annual_temps.latitude AS latitude,
    annual_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_c AS avg_annual_tmean_c
  FROM annual_temps
  WHERE
    annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_k = (
      SELECT
        max_temp_value.highest_avg_k AS highest_avg_k
      FROM max_temp_value
    )
), level1_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,
    h.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
    lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
  FROM hottest_grids AS h
  JOIN landcover_upscaled AS u
    ON u.latitude = h.latitude AND u.longitude = h.longitude
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
  GROUP BY
    h.latitude,
    h.longitude,
    lt.level1_code,
    lt.level1_label
), dominant_per_grid AS (
  SELECT
    level1_counts.latitude AS latitude,
    level1_counts.longitude AS longitude,
    level1_counts.level1_code AS level1_code,
    level1_counts.level1_label AS level1_label,
    level1_counts.total_count AS total_count,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY level1_counts.latitude, level1_counts.longitude
      ORDER BY level1_counts.total_count DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM level1_counts
), hottest_dominant AS (
  SELECT
    d.latitude AS latitude,
    d.longitude AS longitude,
    d.level1_code AS level1_code,
    d.level1_label AS dominant_level1_type,
    d.total_count AS dominant_count,

    MAX(annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_k) AS highest_avg_k
  FROM annual_temps
), hottest_grids AS (
  SELECT
    annual_temps.latitude AS latitude,
    annual_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_c AS avg_annual_tmean_c
  FROM annual_temps
  WHERE
    annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_k = (

  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,

question: Compare annual average temperatures in 2021 between the dominant landcovers of forest and urban in the Canton of Zurich.
sql:
WITH forest_level2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lt1.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt1
  WHERE
    lt1.level2_label ILIKE '%forest%'
), urban_level2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lt2.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt2
  WHERE
    lt2.level2_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), dominant_grids AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    CASE
      WHEN dom.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM forest_level2
      )
      THEN 'Forest'
      WHEN dom.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM urban_level2
      )
      THEN 'Urban'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS landcover_group
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level2_code AS level2_code,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level2_code
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  WHERE
    u.latitude BETWEEN 38.0 AND 38.0
    AND u.longitude BETWEEN 23.7 AND 23.7
    AND dom.level2_code IN (
      SELECT
        forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
      FROM forest_level2
      UNION
      SELECT
        urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
      FROM urban_level2
    )
), annual_temps AS (
  SELECT
    dg.landcover_group AS landcover_group,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) AS year,
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_temp_c,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude) AS num_grids
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_grids AS dg
    ON dg.latitude = t.latitude AND dg.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2021
  GROUP BY
    dg.landcover_group,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time)
)
SELECT
  MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Forest' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) AS forest_avg_c,
  MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Urban' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) AS urban_avg_c,
  MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Urban' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) - MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Forest' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) AS urban_minus_forest_diff_c
FROM annual_temps

question: What is the mean temperature in the canton of City of Athens on 15.07.2020 in areas that include forests?
sql:
SELECT
  t.latitude AS latitude,
  t.longitude AS longitude,
  t.tmean - 273.15 AS temperature_mean,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT lt.level3_code) AS forest_related_codes_present,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT lt.level3_label) AS forest_related_labels_present
FROM meteo_tmean AS t
JOIN landcover_upscaled AS u
  ON u.latitude = t.latitude AND u.longitude = t.longitude
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(val, idx)
JOIN landcover_type AS lt
  ON lt.level3_code = r.val
WHERE
  t.latitude >= 38.0
  AND t.latitude <= 38.0
  AND t.longitude >= 23.7
  AND t.longitude <= 23.7
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2020
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.time) = 7
  AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t.time) = 15
  AND lt.level3_label ILIKE '%forest%'
  AND r.idx % 2 = 1
GROUP BY
  t.latitude,
  t.longitude,
  t.tmean
ORDER BY
  latitude,
  longitude

  ROUND(CAST(week_temps.avg_week_tmean AS DECIMAL), 2) - 273.15 AS avg_week_mean_temperature_celsius
FROM week_temps

  SELECT DISTINCT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY AS r ( code, idx )
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = r.code
  WHERE
    u.latitude BETWEEN 46.2 AND 47.0
    AND u.longitude BETWEEN 6.1 AND 7.2
    AND lt.level3_label ILIKE '%water%'
    AND r.idx % 2 = 1

  SELECT
    t.latitude AS latitude,
    t.longitude AS longitude,

    ON lg.latitude = t.latitude AND lg.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM t.time) = 12 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2020
  GROUP BY
    t.latitude,

)

question: List the different landcover types of City of Athens.
sql:
SELECT
  lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
  lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
  lt.level2_code AS level2_code,
  lt.level2_label AS level2_label,
  lt.level3_code AS level3_code,
  lt.level3_label AS level3_label,
  landcover_filter.total_count AS total_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    lu.ranks[i][1] AS level3_code,
    SUM(lu.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS lu, GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(ranks, 1) AS i
  WHERE
    lu.latitude >= 38.0
    AND lu.latitude <= 38.0
    AND lu.longitude >= 23.7
    AND lu.longitude <= 23.7
  GROUP BY
    lu.ranks[i][1]
) AS landcover_filter
JOIN landcover_type AS lt
  ON lt.level3_code = landcover_filter.level3_code
ORDER BY
  landcover_filter.total_count DESC

question: What is the percentage of each landcover type in the canton of City of Athens?
sql:
WITH canton_totals AS (
  SELECT
    u.ranks[i][1] AS level3_code,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_type_count
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u, GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i

FROM canton_totals AS ct

JOIN landcover_type AS lt
  ON lt.level3_code = ct.level3_code
ORDER BY

question: What is the percentage of land area covered by forests in the cantons of Zurich, Bern, and Geneva, based on the landcover composition data?
sql:
WITH regional_landcover_entries AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 38.0 AND 38.0 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 23.7 AND 23.7
      THEN 'City of Athens'
      WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 46.3 AND 47.4 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 7 AND 8
      THEN 'Canton of Bern'
      WHEN u.latitude BETWEEN 46.1 AND 46.3 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 5.9 AND 6.3
      THEN 'Geneva'
    END AS canton_name,
    lt.level3_label AS level3_label
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(val, idx)
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = r.val
  WHERE
    r.idx % 2 = 1
)
SELECT
  regional_landcover_entries.canton_name AS canton_name,
  ROUND(
    CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      regional_landcover_entries.level3_label ILIKE '%forest%') / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL),
    2
  ) AS forest_entry_percentage
FROM regional_landcover_entries
WHERE
  NOT regional_landcover_entries.canton_name IS NULL
GROUP BY
  regional_landcover_entries.canton_name
ORDER BY
  forest_entry_percentage DESC

question: How did the annual average mean temperature in <urban>-dominated areas of City of Athens in 2020 deviate from the 1991–2020 baseline?
sql:
WITH dominant_level3_grids AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    dom.level3_label AS level3_label
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level3_label AS level3_label,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level3_label
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  WHERE
    u.latitude BETWEEN 38.0 AND 38.0
    AND u.longitude BETWEEN 23.7 AND 23.7
    AND dom.level3_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), temp_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_temp_2020_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_level3_grids AS g
    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    t.time >= CAST('2020-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
), baseline_1991_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS baseline_avg_temp_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_level3_grids AS g
    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    t.time >= CAST('1991-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(CAST(t20.avg_temp_2020_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_temp_2020_c,
  ROUND(CAST(b.baseline_avg_temp_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS baseline_1991_2020_c,
  ROUND(CAST((
    t20.avg_temp_2020_c - b.baseline_avg_temp_c
  ) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS anomaly_c
FROM temp_2020 AS t20
CROSS JOIN baseline_1991_2020 AS b

  SELECT
    mt.latitude AS latitude,
    mt.longitude AS longitude,
    AVG(mt.tmean) AS avg_annual_tmean_k,
    AVG(mt.tmean) - 273.15 AS avg_annual_tmean_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS mt
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mt.time) = 2010
    AND mt.latitude >= 39.0
    AND mt.latitude <= 40.2
    AND mt.longitude >= 21.1
    AND mt.longitude <= 24.4
  GROUP BY
    mt.latitude,
    mt.longitude
), max_temp_value AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_k) AS highest_avg_k
  FROM annual_temps
), hottest_grids AS (
  SELECT
    annual_temps.latitude AS latitude,
    annual_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_c AS avg_annual_tmean_c
  FROM annual_temps
  WHERE
    annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_k = (
      SELECT
        max_temp_value.highest_avg_k AS highest_avg_k
      FROM max_temp_value
    )
), level1_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,
    h.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
    lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
  FROM hottest_grids AS h
  JOIN landcover_upscaled AS u
    ON u.latitude = h.latitude AND u.longitude = h.longitude
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
  GROUP BY
    h.latitude,
    h.longitude,
    lt.level1_code,
    lt.level1_label
), dominant_per_grid AS (
  SELECT
    level1_counts.latitude AS latitude,
    level1_counts.longitude AS longitude,
    level1_counts.level1_code AS level1_code,
    level1_counts.level1_label AS level1_label,
    level1_counts.total_count AS total_count,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY level1_counts.latitude, level1_counts.longitude
      ORDER BY level1_counts.total_count DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM level1_counts
), hottest_dominant AS (
  SELECT
    d.latitude AS latitude,
    d.longitude AS longitude,
    d.level1_code AS level1_code,
    d.level1_label AS dominant_level1_type,
    d.total_count AS dominant_count,
    ROUND(CAST(h.avg_annual_tmean_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS highest_avg_temp_c
  FROM dominant_per_grid AS d
  JOIN hottest_grids AS h
    ON h.latitude = d.latitude AND h.longitude = d.longitude
  WHERE
    d.rnk = 1
)
SELECT
  hottest_dominant.latitude AS latitude,
  hottest_dominant.longitude AS longitude,
  hottest_dominant.level1_code AS level1_code,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_level1_type AS dominant_level1_type,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_count AS dominant_count,
  hottest_dominant.highest_avg_temp_c AS highest_avg_temp_c
FROM hottest_dominant
ORDER BY
  latitude,
  longitude

question: What is the annual average temperature for urban-dominated areas (defined in level 2) in Thessaly Region in 2015?
sql:
WITH urban_level2_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lt1.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt1
  WHERE
    lt1.level2_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), urban_dominant_grids AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level2_code AS level2_code,
      lt.level2_label AS level2_label,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level2_code,
      lt.level2_label
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dominant
  JOIN urban_level2_codes AS ul
    ON ul.level2_code = dominant.level2_code
  WHERE
    (
      ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1) BETWEEN 39.0 AND 40.2
    )
    AND (
      ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1) BETWEEN 21.1 AND 24.4
    )
), annual_temp AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_temp_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN urban_dominant_grids AS ug
    ON ug.latitude = t.latitude AND ug.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2015
)
SELECT
  ROUND(CAST(annual_temp.avg_temp_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS annual_average_temperature_c
FROM annual_temp

question: Compare annual average temperatures in 2021 between the dominant landcovers of forest and urban in the Canton of Zurich.
sql:
WITH forest_level2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lt1.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt1
  WHERE
    lt1.level2_label ILIKE '%forest%'
), urban_level2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lt2.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt2
  WHERE
    lt2.level2_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), dominant_grids AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    CASE
      WHEN dom.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM forest_level2
      )
      THEN 'Forest'
      WHEN dom.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM urban_level2
      )
      THEN 'Urban'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS landcover_group
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level2_code AS level2_code,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level2_code
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  WHERE
    u.latitude BETWEEN 39.0 AND 40.2
    AND u.longitude BETWEEN 21.1 AND 24.4
    AND dom.level2_code IN (
      SELECT
        forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
      FROM forest_level2
      UNION
      SELECT
        urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
      FROM urban_level2
    )
), annual_temps AS (
  SELECT
    dg.landcover_group AS landcover_group,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) AS year,
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_temp_c,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude) AS num_grids
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_grids AS dg
    ON dg.latitude = t.latitude AND dg.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2021
  GROUP BY
    dg.landcover_group,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time)
)
SELECT
  MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Forest' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) AS forest_avg_c,
  MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Urban' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) AS urban_avg_c,
  MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Urban' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) - MAX(
    CASE WHEN annual_temps.landcover_group = 'Forest' THEN annual_temps.avg_temp_c END
  ) AS urban_minus_forest_diff_c
FROM annual_temps

question: For Canton of Zurich, compare the dominant landcovers and their monthly average temperatures of August between 2010 and 2015.
sql:
WITH forest_level2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lt1.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt1
  WHERE
    lt1.level2_label ILIKE '%forest%'
), urban_level2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lt2.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt2
  WHERE
    lt2.level2_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), dominant_per_grid_raw AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level2_code AS dominant_level2_code,
    lt.level2_label AS dominant_level2_label,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
    lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
    CASE
      WHEN lt.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM forest_level2
      )
      THEN 'Forest-dominated'
      WHEN lt.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM urban_level2
      )
      THEN 'Urban-dominated'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS landcover_group,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS dominant_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.latitude, u.longitude ORDER BY SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) DESC) AS rn
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
  WHERE
    u.latitude BETWEEN 39.0 AND 40.2 AND u.longitude BETWEEN 21.1 AND 24.4
  GROUP BY
    u.latitude,
    u.longitude,
    lt.level2_code,
    lt.level2_label,
    lt.level1_code,
    lt.level1_label
), dominant_per_grid AS (
  SELECT
    dominant_per_grid_raw.latitude AS latitude,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.longitude AS longitude,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.dominant_level2_code AS dominant_level2_code,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.dominant_level2_label AS dominant_level2_label,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.level1_code AS level1_code,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.level1_label AS level1_label,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.landcover_group AS landcover_group,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.dominant_count AS dominant_count,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.rn AS rn
  FROM dominant_per_grid_raw
  WHERE
    dominant_per_grid_raw.rn = 1
), august_temps AS (
  SELECT
    d.landcover_group AS landcover_group,
    d.dominant_level2_label AS dominant_level2_label,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) AS year,
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_august_temp_c,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude) AS num_grids
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_per_grid AS d
    ON d.latitude = t.latitude AND d.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    (
      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2010 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.time) = 8
    )
    OR (
      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2015 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.time) = 8
    )
  GROUP BY
    d.landcover_group,
    d.dominant_level2_label,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time)
)
SELECT
  august_temps.year AS year,
  august_temps.landcover_group AS landcover_group,
  august_temps.dominant_level2_label AS most_common_dominant_type_in_group,
  ROUND(CAST(august_temps.avg_august_temp_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_august_temperature_c,
  august_temps.num_grids AS number_of_grid_cells
FROM august_temps
ORDER BY
  year,
  landcover_group,
  august_temps.avg_august_temp_c DESC

question: How did the annual average mean temperature in <urban>-dominated areas of Thessaly Region in 2020 deviate from the 1991–2020 baseline?
sql:
WITH dominant_level3_grids AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    dom.level3_label AS level3_label
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level3_label AS level3_label,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level3_label
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  WHERE
    u.latitude BETWEEN 39.0 AND 40.2
    AND u.longitude BETWEEN 21.1 AND 24.4
    AND dom.level3_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), temp_2020 AS (
  SELECT

  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_level3_grids AS g
    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    t.time >= CAST('2020-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
), baseline_1991_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS baseline_avg_temp_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_level3_grids AS g
    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    t.time >= CAST('1991-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(CAST(t20.avg_temp_2020_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_temp_2020_c,
  ROUND(CAST(b.baseline_avg_temp_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS baseline_1991_2020_c,
  ROUND(CAST((
    t20.avg_temp_2020_c - b.baseline_avg_temp_c
  ) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS anomaly_c
FROM temp_2020 AS t20
CROSS JOIN baseline_1991_2020 AS b

question: What is the first-level landcover type of the location with the highest average temperature in Canton of Zurich on July 15, 2010?
sql:
WITH july15_temps AS (
  SELECT
    mt.latitude AS latitude,
    mt.longitude AS longitude,
    mt.tmean AS tmean_k,
    mt.tmean - 273.15 AS tmean_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS mt
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mt.time) = 2010
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mt.time) = 7
    AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM mt.time) = 15
    AND (ROUND(CAST(mt.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(mt.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((47.4, 8.6))
), max_temp_value AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(july15_temps.tmean_k) AS highest_tmean_k
  FROM july15_temps
), hottest_grid AS (
  SELECT
    july15_temps.latitude AS latitude,
    july15_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    july15_temps.tmean_c AS tmean_c
  FROM july15_temps
  WHERE
    july15_temps.tmean_k = (
      SELECT
        max_temp_value.highest_tmean_k AS highest_tmean_k
      FROM max_temp_value
    )
), level1_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,
    h.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
    lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
  FROM hottest_grid AS h
  JOIN landcover_upscaled AS u
    ON u.latitude = h.latitude AND u.longitude = h.longitude
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
  GROUP BY
    h.latitude,
    h.longitude,
    lt.level1_code,
    lt.level1_label
), dominant_per_grid AS (
  SELECT
    level1_counts.latitude AS latitude,
    level1_counts.longitude AS longitude,
    level1_counts.level1_code AS level1_code,
    level1_counts.level1_label AS level1_label,
    level1_counts.total_count AS total_count,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY level1_counts.latitude, level1_counts.longitude
      ORDER BY level1_counts.total_count DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM level1_counts
), hottest_dominant AS (
  SELECT
    d.latitude AS latitude,
    d.longitude AS longitude,
    d.level1_code AS level1_code,
    d.level1_label AS dominant_level1_type,
    d.total_count AS dominant_count,
    ROUND(CAST(h.tmean_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS highest_avg_temp_c
  FROM dominant_per_grid AS d
  JOIN hottest_grid AS h
    ON h.latitude = d.latitude AND h.longitude = d.longitude
  WHERE
    d.rnk = 1
)
SELECT
  hottest_dominant.latitude AS latitude,
  hottest_dominant.longitude AS longitude,
  hottest_dominant.level1_code AS level1_code,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_level1_type AS dominant_level1_type,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_count AS dominant_count,
  hottest_dominant.highest_avg_temp_c AS highest_avg_temp_c

    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i

      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level2_code
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  JOIN urban_level2 AS ul
    ON ul.level2_code = dom.level2_code
  JOIN zurich_grids AS zg
    ON zg.latitude = u.latitude AND zg.longitude = u.longitude
), urban_dominant_bern AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    'Canton of Bern' AS canton
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level2_code AS level2_code,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level2_code
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  JOIN urban_level2 AS ul
    ON ul.level2_code = dom.level2_code
  JOIN bern_grids AS bg
    ON bg.latitude = u.latitude AND bg.longitude = u.longitude
), urban_grids AS (
  SELECT
    urban_dominant_zurich.latitude AS latitude,
    urban_dominant_zurich.longitude AS longitude,
    urban_dominant_zurich.canton AS canton
  FROM urban_dominant_zurich
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    urban_dominant_bern.latitude AS latitude,
    urban_dominant_bern.longitude AS longitude,
    urban_dominant_bern.canton AS canton
  FROM urban_dominant_bern
), annual_2015_temps AS (
  SELECT
    ug.canton AS canton,
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_annual_temp_c,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude) AS num_urban_dominant_grids,
    MIN(t.tmean - 273.15) AS min_temp_c,
    MAX(t.tmean - 273.15) AS max_temp_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN urban_grids AS ug
    ON ug.latitude = t.latitude AND ug.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) = 2015
  GROUP BY
    ug.canton
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    CAST(MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN annual_2015_temps.canton = 'Canton of Zurich'
        THEN annual_2015_temps.avg_annual_temp_c
      END
    ) AS DECIMAL),
    2
  ) AS zurich_urban_avg_c,
  ROUND(
    CAST(MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN annual_2015_temps.canton = 'Canton of Bern'
        THEN annual_2015_temps.avg_annual_temp_c
      END
    ) AS DECIMAL),
    2
  ) AS bern_urban_avg_c,
  ROUND(
    CAST((
      COALESCE(
        MAX(
          CASE
            WHEN annual_2015_temps.canton = 'Canton of Zurich'
            THEN annual_2015_temps.avg_annual_temp_c
          END
        ),
        0
      ) - COALESCE(
        MAX(
          CASE
            WHEN annual_2015_temps.canton = 'Canton of Bern'
            THEN annual_2015_temps.avg_annual_temp_c
          END
        ),
        0
      )
    ) AS DECIMAL),
    2
  ) AS zurich_urban_minus_bern_urban_diff_c
FROM annual_2015_temps

question: For Canton of Zurich, compare the dominant landcovers and their monthly average temperatures of August between 2010 and 2015.

WITH forest_level2 AS (

    lt1.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt1
  WHERE

), urban_level2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    lt2.level2_code AS level2_code

), dominant_per_grid_raw AS (

    CASE

        FROM forest_level2

      THEN 'Forest-dominated'
      WHEN lt.level2_code IN (
        SELECT

        FROM urban_level2
      )
      THEN 'Urban-dominated'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS landcover_group,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS dominant_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.latitude, u.longitude ORDER BY SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) DESC) AS rn
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
  WHERE
    (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN (

      (47.2, 8.7),
      (47.3, 8.7),
      (47.4, 8.7),
      (47.5, 8.7),
      (47.6, 8.7),
      (47.3, 8.8),
      (47.4, 8.8),
      (47.5, 8.8)
    )
  GROUP BY
    u.latitude,
    u.longitude,
    lt.level2_code,
    lt.level2_label,
    lt.level1_code,
    lt.level1_label
), dominant_per_grid AS (
  SELECT
    dominant_per_grid_raw.latitude AS latitude,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.longitude AS longitude,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.dominant_level2_code AS dominant_level2_code,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.dominant_level2_label AS dominant_level2_label,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.level1_code AS level1_code,

    dominant_per_grid_raw.landcover_group AS landcover_group,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.dominant_count AS dominant_count,
    dominant_per_grid_raw.rn AS rn
  FROM dominant_per_grid_raw
  WHERE
    dominant_per_grid_raw.rn = 1
), august_temps AS (
  SELECT
    d.landcover_group AS landcover_group,
    d.dominant_level2_label AS dominant_level2_label,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) AS year,
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_august_temp_c,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude) AS num_grids
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_per_grid AS d

  ROUND(CAST(august_temps.avg_august_temp_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_august_temperature_c,
  august_temps.num_grids AS number_of_grid_cells

      (47.3, 8.8),

    AND t.time < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)

  FROM meteo_tmean AS t

    ON g.latitude = t.latitude AND g.longitude = t.longitude

  ROUND(CAST((

question: What is the first-level landcover type of the location with the highest average temperature in Canton of Zurich on July 15, 2010?
sql:
WITH july15_temps AS (
  SELECT
    mt.latitude AS latitude,
    mt.longitude AS longitude,
    mt.tmean AS tmean_k,
    mt.tmean - 273.15 AS tmean_c
  FROM meteo_tmean AS mt
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mt.time) = 2010
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mt.time) = 7
    AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM mt.time) = 15
    AND mt.latitude >= 47.2
    AND mt.latitude <= 47.7
    AND mt.longitude >= 8.4
    AND mt.longitude <= 9.0
), max_temp_value AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(july15_temps.tmean_k) AS highest_tmean_k
  FROM july15_temps
), hottest_grid AS (
  SELECT
    july15_temps.latitude AS latitude,
    july15_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    july15_temps.tmean_c AS tmean_c
  FROM july15_temps
  WHERE
    july15_temps.tmean_k = (
      SELECT
        max_temp_value.highest_tmean_k AS highest_tmean_k
      FROM max_temp_value
    )
), level1_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,
    h.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
    lt.level1_label AS level1_label,
    SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
  FROM hottest_grid AS h
  JOIN landcover_upscaled AS u
    ON u.latitude = h.latitude AND u.longitude = h.longitude
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
  GROUP BY
    h.latitude,
    h.longitude,
    lt.level1_code,
    lt.level1_label
), dominant_per_grid AS (
  SELECT
    level1_counts.latitude AS latitude,
    level1_counts.longitude AS longitude,
    level1_counts.level1_code AS level1_code,
    level1_counts.level1_label AS level1_label,
    level1_counts.total_count AS total_count,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY level1_counts.latitude, level1_counts.longitude
      ORDER BY level1_counts.total_count DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM level1_counts
), hottest_dominant AS (
  SELECT
    d.latitude AS latitude,
    d.longitude AS longitude,
    d.level1_code AS level1_code,
    d.level1_label AS dominant_level1_type,
    d.total_count AS dominant_count,
    ROUND(CAST(h.tmean_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS highest_avg_temp_c
  FROM dominant_per_grid AS d
  JOIN hottest_grid AS h
    ON h.latitude = d.latitude AND h.longitude = d.longitude
  WHERE
    d.rnk = 1
)
SELECT
  hottest_dominant.latitude AS latitude,
  hottest_dominant.longitude AS longitude,
  hottest_dominant.level1_code AS level1_code,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_level1_type AS dominant_level1_type,
  hottest_dominant.dominant_count AS dominant_count,
  hottest_dominant.highest_avg_temp_c AS highest_avg_temp_c
FROM hottest_dominant

question: Compare annual average temperatures in 2021 between the dominant landcovers of forest and urban in the Canton of Zurich.
